Begin on the previous scene's exact final state. Hold SOLOIST's raised-hand pose and world root; hold CHORUS at the translated endpoint with unit spacing and unchanged facing; stage GATE shut at the far edge. Make no pose, formation, prop, or world transition. End on the same state after it has been available for observation.

Entry and exit are physically identical: hand raised, SOLOIST root at `plaza-center`, CHORUS translated 2 m with unit spacing, GATE at zero degrees, ground unchanged. The executable action is a complete hold of those channels.

No participant receives new information and the production asserts no private mental state. The audience alone changes from recognizing a response to judging it durable because the endpoint survives the transition, sustained observation, and unchanged boundary.
